title: The Book That Saved the Earth

topics.title: The Historian's introduction: the Era of the Book

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how the Historian describes the twentieth century and the Martian invasion of 2040.
Explain how the Historian and the historiscope frame the events of the play.

topics.title: Think-Tank and Noodle at Mars Space Control

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the vanity, arrogance and impatience of Think-Tank from his words and actions.
Describe Noodle's humble, obedient manner towards Think-Tank.

topics.title: The crew in the library: books as hats and sandwiches

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the wrong guesses the Martians make about the library and its books.
Explain the humour of the crew passing on Think-Tank's order to eat the 'sandwich'.

topics.title: Communication sandwiches, the code and the vitamins

concepts.learning_objective: Trace how Think-Tank's theory of 'communication sandwiches' and the 'code' develops.
Analyse how Noodle corrects Think-Tank's mistakes without offending him.
Interpret how Think-Tank reads innocent nursery rhymes as threats from Earth.
Explain why the Humpty Dumpty rhyme makes Think-Tank abandon the invasion and flee.

topics.title: The Historian's epilogue and the play's message

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how relations between Earth and Mars stand in the twenty-fifth century.
Evaluate the play's irony and use words from the chapter's glossary correctly.
